lead: Kiran Bedi is an Indian police officer, born on 9 June 1949 in Amritsar.
As of 2026, she is 77 years old, and her birth date places her under the Gemini sign.
She has held the office of Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry and has been recognised with Ramon Magsaysay Award and Jawarharlal Nehru Fellowship.
